task: Q196 (2026-10-06): does a genuine UNADAPTED FEMALE BASE atlas model with an open licence exist and can it be downloaded here?
verdict: NO. No open, downloadable, whole-body, FMA/TA-labelled female atlas exists in anything reachable from this sandbox. Z-Anatomy and BodyParts3D ship one male-derived body. Fallback built: the generic Z-Anatomy body with the 27 male-only objects removed, nothing fitted (build/viewer_base_female_q196). Not a female body; labelled as such on the page and in the hub.

A female release therefore could not be verified at the origin, but none is listed by any reachable mirror, README or the Z-Anatomy NOTICE.

male_base_repairs.evidence: default path of build_zan_atlas_viewer.py never imports a Visible Human transfer; only --target-body vhf (fitted female) or Q195's vhm path do

repairs_carried.contralateral_replacements: 3 left-side source objects replaced by the mirrored right side (iliopsoas fascia l: displaced ~19 mm; iliopectineal arch l: 23-vertex stub; zonular fibres l: 0.3 mm stub); 1,237 L/R pairs audited, 14 flagged (list in the report)
repairs_carried.declarative_correction: 1 file, data/corrections/zanatomy/radial_n.json (posterior interosseous nerve, both sides; cited)
repairs_carried.muscle_gap_closure: 410 of 412 movable muscles shifted <= 3 mm toward a 1 mm interface (Stecco 2008, Pirri 2021); median gap 1.15 -> 0.87 mm; vertices inside a neighbour 10.1 -> 9.7 %; each moved muscle badged
repairs_carried.source_cleaning: 56 decal/origin-insertion-marker objects dropped, 1 unplaced prototype, 1 vessel name-map split, 4 sides inferred, 2 swapped; meshes welded and oriented outward; frame origin moved to the hip-joint midpoint
repairs_carried.skin: 250 Integument patches shipped as their own layer; hair (6 objects) not shipped
repairs_carried.decimation: quadric edge collapse to 3.14 M triangles
